title: The sample contains only returning aircraft
caption: Conceptual illustration, not historical damage records. Bullet holes show damage that returning aircraft survived. Sparse hits in critical areas can signal missing aircraft, not safety, when comparable exposure and damage-dependent survival are plausible. The next figure demonstrates the selection mechanism with synthetic data.
